name: template
description: GENERIC DOMAIN-AGNOSTIC template — copy this to examples/<your-name>.json before editing. Before you edit it for your app, read CLAUDE.md + AGENTS.md and keep ALL content domain-agnostic: no app/company/screen/persona names, no credentials, no device IDs — use ${vars} for anything machine- or environment-specific. Companion walkthrough: TEMPLATE.md. This shows the common moving parts (vars, a deterministic code phase, an agent phase, a fan-out map, a nested subflow, triggers, a budget, lifecycle) — delete what you don't need.

phases.name: prepare-input
phases.description: Deterministic setup — a pure-JS code phase costs zero tokens. Normalize / parse / reshape the input here instead of spending a model call. `code.source` runs sandboxed JS (no fs/network); prefer it. (`code.run` shells a real process and needs SAMMY_ALLOW_CODE_RUN=1 — see TEMPLATE.md.)

phases.name: do-the-work
phases.description: An agent phase — the model-in-the-loop kind. Bound it: maxTurns caps its lifespan, timeout caps wallclock, retry re-attempts transient failures. The prompt is interpolated, so ${prepared} (the prior phase, stored via `as`) and ${vars.threshold} resolve here.
phases.prompt: Work item: ${prepared}. Apply threshold ${vars.threshold}. Produce a JSON array of result objects.

phases.name: process-each
phases.description: Fan-out: run one body per array item from ${results}. Each item is ${item} (position ${index}). `serial:false` runs them concurrently (bounded by SAMMY_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS); `concurrency` caps how many run at once within this map.

phases.name: nested-flow
phases.description: Compose a tested sub-orchestration by name (its `phases` run; state is shared, so ${processed} is visible inside). Point this at any orchestration in examples/, or delete this phase.

phases.name: final-review
phases.description: A human-approval gate: `lock: true` pauses the run until someone approves. Use it at any decision that needs a human or precedes an irreversible step.
phases.prompt:
Review the processed results before we finish:
${processed}
